sections.title: Bosch GLM 50 C
content: El Bosch GLM 50 C impresiona con su visor digital de 5 megapíxeles y zoom ajustable, permitiendo localizar el punto láser a grandes distancias. Con capacidad de medir hasta 400 pies y una precisión de +/- 1/16 de pulgada, este dispositivo es esencial para trabajos en condiciones de poca luz gracias a su pantalla iluminada en color. Además, su cristal de pantalla reforzado ofrece durabilidad y resistencia al daño, haciendo de este dispositivo una herramienta confiable para cualquier ingeniero civil.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 252 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: DIGITAL VIEWFINDER: delivers 5.0 megapixels with adjustable zoom to locate the laser spot at far distances.
ACCURACY: The laser measures up to 400 feet and provides accuracy up to +/- 1/16 inch.
BACKLIT COLOR DISTPLAY: The easy-to-read display illuminates numbers with distinct resolution, for work in low-light or no-light conditions.
REINFORCED SCREEN GLASS: The screen glass provides increased durability and damage resistance.
MEASURING FEATURES: The laser measure includes 11 different measuring functions, including real-time length, length, area, volume and indirect functions, and addition/subtraction capability.

sections.title: Level Sensor Moasure ONE
content: Lo que nadie te dice del Level Sensor Moasure ONE es que combina una cinta métrica digital de 12 pies y un medidor láser de 330 pies en una herramienta compacta. Gracias a su diseño modular, puedes separar el módulo láser para mayor versatilidad y conveniencia. Esto, junto con su tecnología Super OptiTracking, garantiza precisión en cualquier ambiente de trabajo, haciendo del Moasure ONE un aliado indispensable para proyectos de renovación.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 699 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
visuals: Product image: Level Sensor Moasure ONE
features: [Effortless Measuring, Near or Far] Combines a 12ft digital tape measure and a 330ft laser distance meter in one compact tool—no need to switch devices. Easily handle short, detailed measurements for woodworking or long-distance measuring for home renovation, construction, and DIY projects with speed and accuracy

[Modular Design for Versatility & Convenience] Features an innovative detachable design that allows the laser module to be easily separated from the tape. Replace worn tape components or switch between metric, imperial, and split units with ease—offering greater flexibility, longer product lifespan, and a more convenient measuring experience

[Reliable Accuracy in Any Environment] Powered by advanced Super OptiTracking technology, XTAPE1 tape measure delivers precision up to ±1/32" with consistent, dependable results—even in demanding jobsite conditions. Built for professionals and DIYers alike, it ensures accurate measurements you can trust anytime, anywhere

[Precision Alignment Made Easy] Equipped with a high-visibility green laser line, XTAPE1 delivers superior brightness and extended range for accurate cross-surface alignment. Perfect for marking and positioning on uneven surfaces, it ensures straight, precise results for renovation, installation, and woodworking tasks

[Seamless Data Sync & Smart Documentation] Easily transfer measurement data to your smartphone or tablet via the dedicated app—no more juggling between notes and measurements. Annotate dimensions directly on hand-drawn sketches or on-site photos, keeping your projects organized, accurate, and efficient
